description: RULED by the USER 2026-10-10 03:45 after docs/production-readiness-review-s513.md named a pure-Perl Encode shim the single most valuable production unblocker (`use Encode` fails today: 'the module is XS and has no PCL build'; it is in most non-ASCII text-processing programs; Text::CSV_PP uses it).  LAYER (rule 9a): the module's behaviour -- exports, constants, the CHECK fallback modes, aliases, the Encoding objects -- is plain Perl in lib/Encode.pm (+ lib/Encode/Encoding.pm, lib/Encode/Alias.pm unless perl's own pure-Perl copies load under PCL, lib/PerlIO/encoding.pm stub); the runtime gains only what no Perl can say: `builtin::encode_octets(NAME, STR, STOP)` and `builtin::decode_octets(NAME, OCTETS, STOP)` through the ONE codec table `%p-encoding-ef` (what `:encoding(NAME)` accepts, Encode accepts; an unknown name dies perl-shaped `Unknown encoding`), returning the result and the index of the first unmappable character / malformed byte so every CHECK mode is written in the shim.  Result FORM: decode = the upgraded form (utf8::is_utf8 true even for ASCII), encode = the byte form.  Strict 'UTF-8' vs lax 'utf8' (surrogates, > 0x10FFFF).  UTF-16/32 BOM rules.  Encodings SBCL has no codec for (big5, euc-kr, iso-2022-*) die perl-shaped and get ONE not-supported entry; Encode::Guess / MIME-Header out of scope.  BAR: guard Pl/t/encode-shim-01.t (~45 rows, perl's answers, inverse-verified: the module does not load on the base), a ~60-row probe matrix perl -> tree, the Text-CSV-2.04 dist (cpan-tests/modules) base vs tree with its three `use Encode` t/ files, the full sweep (lib/ + cl/ change), companion --quick once (uni/, io/utf8.t, io/layers.t), board 0 NEW / 0 LOST, everyday 114 -> 114 (none uses Encode).  Brief: briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s513/s513i-prompt.md; agent IDs 3060-3079 for sub-tasks and findings.  Follow-ups once it lands (the review's order): Storable, File::Glob, Sys::Hostname, Digest::MD5 shims.
subject: THE ENCODE SHIM (USER PRIORITY 2026-10-10: "Put the Encode shim high in priority"): lib/Encode.pm in pure Perl over ONE generic runtime primitive pair (string <-> octets under a named external format, reporting the first failure position) -- encode/decode/encode_utf8/decode_utf8/is_utf8/from_to/find_encoding/resolve_alias/encodings + every CHECK mode (FB_DEFAULT CROAK QUIET WARN PERLQQ HTMLCREF XMLCREF LEAVE_SRC STOP_AT_PARTIAL, a CODE ref) + Encode::Encoding objects + PerlIO::encoding stub; batch s513i
